[[Al Shabab FC (Riyadh)|Al-Shabab]] were the defending champions, but they were eliminated by [[Al Wehda FC|Al-Wehda]] in the first stage of the Golden Four. [[Al-Ittihad Club (Jeddah)|Al-Ittihad]], who finished second with a 5-point difference from first place [[Al Hilal SFC|Al-Hilal]], went on to win the league 2–1 in Riyadh. [[Hamad Al-Montashari]]'s header gave Al-Ittihad their 7th league title in the 94th minute of the match. ==Qualification and prize money== Prize Money: * First Place: 2.5 million Saudi riyals * Second Place: 1.5 million Saudi riyals * Third Place: 1 million Saudi riyals ==Clubs== ===Stadia and locations=== {{Location map+ |Saudi Arabia |width=400 |float=right |caption=Locations of teams in the 2006–07 Saudi Professional League |places= {{Location map~ |Saudi Arabia |lat=21.54333 |long=39.17278 |label=[[Jeddah]] |position=left}} {{Location map~ |Saudi Arabia |lat=24.68800|long=46.72243 |label=[[Riyadh]] |position=left}} {{Location map~ |Saudi Arabia |lat=26.40000|long=50.15000 |label=[[Dammam]] |position=right}} {{Location map~ |Saudi Arabia |lat=27.516667|long=41.683333 |label=[[Ḥaʼil]] }} {{Location map~ |Saudi Arabia |lat=26.28333|long=50.20000 |label=[[Khobar]] }} {{Location map~ |Saudi Arabia |lat=21.41667|long=39.81667 |label=[[Mecca]] }} {{Location map~ |Saudi Arabia |lat=25.86834|long=43.51289 |label=[[Ar Rass]] |position=left}} {{Location map~ |Saudi Arabia |lat=25.916667|long=45.333333 |label=[[Harmah]]}} {{Location map~ |Saudi Arabia |lat=26.475|long=50.041667 |label=[[Saihat]] |position=top}} }} {| class="wikitable sortable" |- !
